note: Design 7:220 - the variant replaces the corrected multiplier with 1 after record validation; the corrected expected producer remains at quantity 5, so the check must refuse at the quantity node. AMBIGUITY RECORDED (discrepancy D-14): if the variant also rewrites /EVENT_SURFACE/decision_events/1/contract_multiplier, that node precedes fill_events in UTF-8 key order (decision_events < fill_events) and would be the first changed node instead. The design names the quantity node; this catalog records the design's node and flags the ordering risk.

Design 7:220 - the variant makes a supplied binary64 NaN stop return zero quantity; RULE2-01-GREEN still expects fallback quantity 1, so the check must refuse at the quantity node (expected 1, variant 0).

Design 8:245 - the variant changes the corrected comparison to > so equality refuses; the RULE-2-GREEN cross-version check must refuse on the admission/refusal projection for RULE2-02-GREEN. Under the variant the corrected side resolves REFUSAL(REFUSED_MIN_NOTIONAL) while the legacy side resolves PRESENT(B:1) at /RESULT_SURFACE/admitted; design 15.3:510 counts present-versus-refusal as unequal. Scope note: design 15.3:476 makes the cross-version GREEN check compare ONLY the declared shared behavioral projection, so the first changed node is taken within that projection. The variant also changes /EVENT_SURFACE/decision_events/3/decision and empties /EVENT_SURFACE/fill_events, which the separate corrected-expectation check would catch earlier in enumeration order.

Design 9:263 - mutate one record byte without updating the detached digest; the record-identity preflight must refuse before any scenario output exists. Because the refusal precedes scenario output there is no comparison-surface node to name; the first changed artifact is the frozen record file itself. DESIGN v1.5 UPDATE: design 22.3:751-753 now binds the record id SYNTH-INSTRUMENT-RULE2-03-RED-V1 and :764-794 binds every record member value, but 22.1:697-700 fixes only sorted keys, no BOM, LF, final LF, duplicate-key refusal and finite tokens, and :758-761 refuses to fabricate provenance captured_at_utc and human_reviewer, so the exact record bytes and their detached .sha256 still do not exist. The node therefore stays BLOCKED-MISSING-RECORD-BYTES (discrepancy D-15, extended by V15-D05). The subject producer is KERNEL_2 because design 15.4 assigns the record-identity preflight to KERNEL_1 and KERNEL_2; this probe binds the corrected subject named by DEF-P012-03.

Design 10:291 - the variant returns stop 100 rather than open 90 on RED; the check must refuse at the fill-price node (expected 90, variant 100). AMBIGUITY RECORDED (discrepancy D-14): under this bundle's node layout three other nodes also change and precede final_fill_price in enumeration order - /EVENT_SURFACE/decision_events/1/reference_price and /EVENT_SURFACE/decision_events/1/reference_source (decision_events sorts before fill_events), and /EVENT_SURFACE/fill_events/0/fill_trigger (the key 'fill_trigger' sorts before 'final_fill_price' because byte 3 is 'l' 0x6c versus 'n' 0x6e). This catalog records the design's named node; the layout-dependent earlier nodes are flagged for section-16 review.

Design 11:319 - the variant omits the slippage application, so the actual fill is 100 against independent corrected expected 101. Within the fill row, UTF-8 key order puts final_fill_price before slippage_impact/slippage_application_count/unrounded_fill_price, so it is the first changed node.

Design 11:319 - the variant applies the slippage twice, so the actual fill is 102 against independent corrected expected 101. Design 11:311 also refuses any second application via slippage_application_count; final_fill_price still precedes slippage_application_count in UTF-8 key order.

Design 12:347 binds this probe exactly once to base_scenario_id RULE2-06-RED, subject_producer_id KERNEL_2 and target kind KERNEL, and states the refusal is at the first changed event sequence node: expected first fill TARGET-NEAR, modified-kernel first fill TARGET-FAR. In this bundle's node layout the reversed order first shows at /EVENT_SURFACE/decision_events/2/ordered_chosen_exit_ids/0 (decision_events precedes fill_events in UTF-8 key order), then at /EVENT_SURFACE/fill_events/0/exit_id. Both are recorded; the design's named node is /EVENT_SURFACE/fill_events/0/exit_id. Discrepancy D-14.

Design 13:388 - the variant classifies one declared taker exit as maker; the check must refuse at the event-role/rate/fee nodes even if a coincidental rounded total is equal. The exit fill is fill index 1, so the projected row is fee_events/1. D-16 RESOLVED AT DESIGN v1.5: design 22.3:799 now binds maker_rate 0.00015 on every section-22 CostSchedule, including RULE2-07, so the maker misclassification is fully derivable. Variant fee_notional 100 times 0.00015 equals 0.015 against the expected taker 100 times 0.001 equals 0.1, so fee_amount, fee_cash_delta and the joined cash row all change. Under the design 15.3:508 UTF-8 byte-order walk cash_events sorts before fee_events, so the first changed node is /EVENT_SURFACE/cash_events/1/signed_delta (expected -0.1, variant -0.015); the design-named event-role node /EVENT_SURFACE/fee_events/1/liquidity_role and /EVENT_SURFACE/fee_events/1/fee_amount also change and are recorded here. This matches the treatment already used for PROBE-P012-08-A.

Design 14:433 - the variant flips the sign for the long positive-rate event; the check must refuse at the cash-delta node because independent expected -0.1 differs from actual +0.1. cash_events precedes funding_events in UTF-8 key order, so the joined cash row's signed_delta is the first changed node; /EVENT_SURFACE/funding_events/0/funding_cash_delta is the typed projection the design names.
